target.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto
target.body:
Closes #106231

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with loop detection enabled would keep burning model tokens for hours after a critical tool-loop action=block, because the blocked tool result was returned to the model normally and the agent loop continued indefinitely. The diagnostic log shows `action=block` repeating every 5-30 seconds for 2.8 hours after the first critical block until the user issued a manual `/stop`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix uses a **dual-layer termination strategy** to handle all batch shapes:

1. **Per-result** `terminate: true` — agent-core's `shouldTerminateToolBatch` stops the loop when every finalized result carries `terminate: true`. This handles single-tool batches and all-veto batches.
2. **Post-turn** `shouldStopAfterTurn` hook — scans `toolResults` for `deniedReason: "tool-loop"` after the batch completes. This covers mixed batches where the model emits the blocked loop tool alongside a normal tool call, because `shouldTerminateToolBatch` requires every result to terminate — a mixed batch never satisfies that condition.

Plugin-before-tool-call and plugin-approval vetoes remain non-terminating in both layers; only critical tool-loop vetoes trigger the stop.

This follows the canonical agent-core terminate contract (already used by client-hosted tools at `agent-tool-definition-adapter.ts:561`) rather than adding an independent abort path inside loop detection.

## User Impact

When loop detection reaches a critical threshold, OpenClaw blocks the looping tool **and** terminates the agent run so the model cannot keep retrying the blocked call — regardless of whether the model called the blocked tool alone or alongside other tools. Warning thresholds and post-compaction guard behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

**Unit tests — terminate flag behavior (4/4 passed):**
```
agent-tools.before-tool-call.blocked-result.test.ts
  ✓ includes terminate: true for critical tool-loop vetoes
  ✓ does not include terminate for plugin-before-tool-call vetoes
  ✓ does not include terminate for plugin-approval vetoes
  ✓ defaults deniedReason to plugin-before-tool-call when omitted
```

**E2E tool-loop detection (83/83 passed):**
`expectToolLoopBlockedResult` asserts `record.terminate === true` on every critical block path (generic_repeat, known_poll_no_progress, ping_pong). All 83 tests green.

**Agent-core terminate contract (26/26 passed):**
Full `agent-loop.test.ts` suite green, including the critical proofs:
- "stops after a tool result only when the finalized result explicitly terminates" — proves per-result terminate for single-tool batches
- "stops after a mixed batch with one critical veto when shouldStopAfterTurn checks for tool-loop" — **new regression test** proving mixed-batch termination: two tools in one assistant response (veto + normal), post-turn hook catches the veto, loop exits after one turn
- "continues after a side-effect tool result when afterToolCall records it without terminate" — proves non-blocked results still continue

**Whitespace:** `git diff --check` — clean

**Format:** `oxfmt --check` on all touched files — clean

**Changes scope:**
```
 packages/agent-core/src/agent.ts                              |  7 ++++
 packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts                    | 67 ++++++++++++++++++++++
 src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.ts                    |  9 ++--
 src/agents/sessions/sdk.ts                                    | 14 ++++++
 4 files changed, 93 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
```

**Proof chain (how the fix works end-to-end):**

Layer 1 — per-result terminate (single-tool batches):
1. `buildBlockedToolResult({ deniedReason: "tool-loop" })` sets `terminate: true` on the blocked result
2. agent-core's `executeToolCalls` → `shouldTerminateToolBatch(finalizedCalls)` checks `every(finalized.result.terminate === true)` at `agent-loop.ts:807`
3. When every call terminates, the batch returns `terminate: true` → `hasMoreToolCalls = false` → loop exits

Layer 2 — post-turn stop (mixed batches):
1. After the batch completes, agent-core calls `shouldStopAfterTurn` with the final `toolResults`
2. `AgentSession.shouldStopAfterTurn` iterates `toolResults` looking for `details.deniedReason === "tool-loop"`
3. When found, returns `true` → loop emits `agent_end` before requesting another model turn

Both layers are independent: the per-result flag handles the common case, and the post-turn hook catches mixed batches. If either layer stops, the loop exits.

**Non-goals:** No changes to `loopDetection` config, warning thresholds, detectors, post-compaction guard, abort/signal machinery, or non-tool-loop blocked results.
